title: mutation-storm
objective: Edit and delete messages around a committed boundary; the engine rolls back correctly and the player can tell what happened.

checks.goal: a boundary is committed and a gate latches from a scripted turn

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 2 }); const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`extraction not configured after import: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

send_generate.text: I get close to the job board and read the postings.

extract.debugResponse: DELTA q=approached_board value=true evidence="I get close to the job board"

checks.goal: editing the message that carried the delta rolls the story back The check first waits for the group round J6.1 started to finish: a send returns before every member has replied, and an edit made mid-round is rolled back and then followed by the remaining replies' boundaries, which is a different scenario (L2 2026-09-23: J6.2 timed out on a still-generating round and J6.4 lost its notice to those boundaries).

edit.text: I stay by the door and order a drink instead.

checks.goal: deleting the last message leaves engine state consistent, not orphaned

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length; const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.lastMessageId >= chat) throw new Error(`engine points past the chat: lastMessageId=${state.lastMessageId} chatLength=${chat}`); return { boundary: snapshot.boundary, chat, lastMessageId: state.lastMessageId };

checks.goal: the player is told the story stepped back after a mutation

checks.prompt: After you edited and deleted messages, was it clear what the story did in response?
checks.anchors: 1 = no idea, felt broken · 3 = worked it out from the drawer · 5 = the system said what it did

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const to = rt.getEngineState().lastMessageId - 1; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugEpistemicResponse = `[knows] Arin | the ferryman takes no coin after dark`; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugLedgerResponse = `[state:Arin:character] condition=healthy`; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugSceneSummaryResponse = `NONE`; const wrote = await rt.runEpistemicLedgerPass({ id: "j6-derived-1", createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: "scene:location", contractHash: "j6", scope: [], window: { from: 0, to }, prompt: "", rawResponse: "", acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [], sceneBreak: { at: to, reason: "location" } }); const belief = rt.getEpistemic().filter((entry) => entry.subject === `Arin` && !entry.supersededBy); const view = rt.getLedger().filter((row) => row.entity === `Arin` && row.field === `condition`); if (!belief.length) throw new Error(`the reveal never landed (wrote=${wrote}): ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.epistemic)}`); if (!view.some((row) => row.value === `healthy`)) throw new Error(`the ledger never took the first value (wrote=${wrote}): ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.ledger)}`); globalThis.__j6Belief = belief[0].id; return { wrote, to, belief: belief[0].id, messageId: belief[0].messageId };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const active = rt.getEpistemic().filter((entry) => !entry.supersededBy); const index = active.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__j6Belief) + 1; if (index < 1) throw new Error(`the belief is not in the pass's own numbered list: ${JSON.stringify(active.map((entry) => entry.id))}`); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugEpistemicResponse = `[retire] ${index}`; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugLedgerResponse = `[state:Arin:character] condition=wounded`; const to = rt.getEngineState().lastMessageId; const wrote = await rt.runEpistemicLedgerPass({ id: "j6-derived-2", createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: "scene:location", contractHash: "j6", scope: [], window: { from: 0, to }, prompt: "", rawResponse: "", acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [], sceneBreak: { at: to, reason: "location" } }); const after = rt.getEpistemic().find((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__j6Belief); const view = rt.getLedger().filter((row) => row.entity === `Arin` && row.field === `condition`); if (!after?.supersededBy) throw new Error(`the reveal never retired the belief (wrote=${wrote}): ${JSON.stringify(after)}`); if (!view.some((row) => row.value === `wounded`)) throw new Error(`the ledger never took the update (wrote=${wrote}): ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.ledger)}`); return { wrote, to, retiredAt: after.retiredAt, view };

edit.text: I stay by the door and leave the posting unread.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const view = rt.getLedger().filter((row) => row.entity === `Arin` && row.field === `condition`); const belief = rt.getEpistemic().find((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__j6Belief); if (view.some((row) => row.value === `wounded`)) throw new Error(`the rolled-back update is still in the ledger: ${JSON.stringify(view)}`); if (!view.some((row) => row.value === `healthy`)) throw new Error(`the prior value did not return: ${JSON.stringify(view)}`); if (!belief) throw new Error(`the belief was dropped by the rollback instead of being un-retired: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.epistemic)}`); if (belief.supersededBy) throw new Error(`the retirement survived the rollback: ${JSON.stringify(belief)}`); return { view, belief: belief.id, run: rt.getRunContext(), notice: rt.getSnapshot().lastRollback };
